description:
Read aggregate consent statistics for one site and an explicit local-calendar date range. Thin wrapper over GET /api/v1/sites/:id/consent-stats; requires sites:read.

from and to are required real YYYY-MM-DD dates; to is inclusive, maximum 366 calendar days. tz is a valid IANA zone, default Europe/Brussels. Local midnights and grouping honor DST, including 23/25-hour days.

Definitions: impressions = banner_shown; accepts = accept; rejects = reject; customs = preferences_saved; dismissals = banner_dismissed. Accept, reject, custom and dismissal are exclusive outcome event types. Dismissal means closing the banner, NOT no interaction. noInteraction = max(0, impressions minus those four outcomes): banner seen without one of these outcomes. Counts are recorded events, not unique people or sessions.

Returns site {id,domain}, period {from,to,tz}, generatedAt, totals, rates (acceptRate/rejectRate/customRate/dismissalRate/noInteractionRate; percentages of impressions rounded to one decimal, null with zero impressions), daily and weekly with the same counts and rates, devices and countries (top 10 by impressions, each with acceptRate), and dataCompleteness {firstEventAt,lastEventAt,daysWithData,daysInPeriod}.

Daily includes only local days with recorded analytics events; absent days are unknown, not fabricated zero days. Weekly uses ISO week-year/week and full Monday–Sunday labels, counting only events inside the requested range. firstEventAt/lastEventAt are UTC timestamps within this range, or null. daysWithData counts any recorded analytics event, not proof of continuous tracking. Missing/invalid country and device labels are grouped as unknown. Recorded duplicates or missing impressions can make outcome rates exceed 100%; no visitor-level deduplication is invented.

Only aggregates: no visitors, IP addresses, consent ids or raw events; no benchmarks, recommendations, revenue or conversion estimates. 400 for invalid range/tz, ownership-hidden 404 and scope 403 follow v1.

to.description: Last local date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; maximum 366 days.

name: consentease_get_consent_stats
title: Get consent statistics
